name: Maison Rose — Eternal Invitation
description: An ethereal botanical blush wedding celebration crafted with warm cream undertones, soft dusty peach, delicate floral borders, interactive Scratch-to-Reveal secret love note, editorial timeline, photo gallery lightbox, and one-tap WhatsApp RSVP.
